summary: Iteration 4 — Magic Link / Lupa NIK feature end-to-end verified. 11/11 new backend tests pass, 20/20 regression portal tests pass, full UI flow (forgot → mock link → magic-login → /portal dashboard) works as designed. Invalid-token error UI also works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is large (>1700 lines). Consider modularising portal vs admin routes into separate routers/files for maintainability — not blocking for this iteration.

PortalMagicLogin.jsx does a setTimeout(600ms) before window.location.href = '/portal'. Works but the success screen is shown for less than a second; could be slightly longer (~1s) for better UX feedback. Minor polish only.

/api/portal/forgot returns {ok: true} for unknown email but {ok: true, status: 'mocked', magic_link_preview: ...} for known email. The PRESENCE of the status/magic_link keys still leaks enumeration if attacker inspects response keys. Acceptable in mock mode for demo; in production (RESEND_API_KEY set), status='sent' and magic_link_preview=null which equalises shape better — but keys still differ. Consider returning identical JSON shape (e.g., always {ok:true}) for stronger anti-enumeration. Tests already enforce that magic_link_preview is absent/null for unknown email.
